topic: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood
mainFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
supportingDetails: Two hearts pump blood through the gills and the third pumps it to the rest of the body.
Their blood is blue because it uses a copper-based protein called hemocyanin to carry oxygen.
About two-thirds of an octopus's neurons are in its arms, not its central brain.
source: Smithsonian Ocean: Octopuses; Encyclopaedia Britannica: Octopus
caption: Three hearts AND blue blood. Which animal fact blew your mind the most? 🐙

scenes.narration: This animal has three hearts. Seriously.
scenes.headline: Three hearts?!

scenes.narration: Meet the octopus! Eight arms, no bones, and inside its soft body, it has not one, but three hearts.
scenes.headline: The octopus

visual.caption: Soft body, eight arms, three hearts

scenes.narration: Two small hearts push blood through the gills, where it picks up oxygen from the water.
scenes.headline: Two hearts for the gills

scenes.narration: Then the third heart, the big one, pumps that blood to the rest of its body.
scenes.headline: One heart for the body

scenes.narration: Fun twist. When an octopus swims, that main heart stops beating. That may be why they prefer crawling!
scenes.headline: Swimming stops a heart

scenes.narration: And their blood is blue! It uses copper to carry oxygen. Our blood uses iron, so ours is red.
scenes.headline: Blue blood

visual.caption: Copper in its blood makes it blue

scenes.narration: One more thing. About two thirds of an octopus's brain cells are in its arms, not its head.
scenes.headline: Smart arms

visual.label: brain cells are in its arms

scenes.narration: So each arm can explore, touch, and taste things on its own. Like eight curious helpers!
scenes.headline: Eight curious arms

visual.label: arms that explore on their own

scenes.narration: Quick recap. Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood, and arms that can almost think for themselves.
scenes.headline: Quick recap

scenes.narration: Follow Pip for a new mind-blowing fact every day!
scenes.headline: A new fact every day!
